# AnkiGen, vendored

The deck builder and data bundles of [AnkiGen](https://github.com/xenohunter/ankigen) at commit `faab49b542ee88f61e25de1d82677785e95865e7`, data version `2026.10.18`, copied unmodified by `node tools/vendor-ankigen.mjs <checkout>`. The bundles are AnkiGen's own output (`node tools/bundle.mjs`), without the interface-text bundles.

- Code (`src/`, `css/`): MIT, `LICENSE` (Copyright Phil Filippak).
- Data (`bundles/`, `data/`): CC BY-SA 4.0, `data/LICENSE.md`. Attribution: "AnkiGen vocabulary, https://github.com/xenohunter/ankigen". The vocabulary was drafted with an AI model and is being reviewed by people.
- `vendor/fflate.js` is Vocella's: a one-line re-export of `../../fflate.js` at the path `src/deck/apkg.js` imports.
